Project Coordinator, Store Rollouts
Larkfield Brands, Inc. (remote within Ohio, up to 25% travel)

Who we are
Larkfield operates 140 specialty retail stores across the Midwest. Our Store Development team plans and runs remodels, new openings, and fixture rollouts.

The opportunity
As Project Coordinator you will support project managers in delivering store remodel and rollout projects on time and on budget. This is a great opportunity for a rockstar who is passionate about retail and ready to hit the ground running.

Key responsibilities
- Build and maintain project schedules in Smartsheet and track milestones across 10-15 concurrent store projects
- Coordinate vendors, contractors, and store teams for install dates and site readiness
- Track project budgets and purchase orders; flag variances to the project manager
- Prepare meeting agendas, take notes, and follow up on action items
- Maintain project documentation and lessons-learned logs

Required qualifications
- 1-3 years of project coordination or related experience
- Proficiency with Smartsheet, MS Project, or similar project management tools
- Strong organizational skills and the ability to juggle competing deadlines
- Excellent written and verbal communication
- Proficient in Microsoft Office, especially Excel

Nice to have
- CAPM or PMP certification, or working toward one
- Retail store operations experience
- Experience working with general contractors or facilities teams

Pay: $24.00 - $28.00 per hour, non-exempt, overtime eligible. Medical, dental, 401(k) with match.
